# Pinned Jaeckel baseline via the vollib repository

Source repository: https://github.com/vollib/lets_be_rational
Pinned commit: `83ae882df8e19323798c7ebfb8898f94d2d92ade` (2015-04-04).
Files in this directory are fetched unchanged from `src/` at that commit.
The copyright/permission text in each source file is retained.

The author's download URL is https://www.jaeckel.org/LetsBeRational.7z . It was
not accessible in this session, so this is explicitly a pinned historical
distribution via vollib, not a verified copy of the latest author archive.

No SWIG, installer, package setup code or upstream build script is executed.
Only the small C++ numerical core is compiled, one translation unit at a time,
with our own local wrapper. Compiler flags and file hashes are recorded.

Retrieved 2026-09-26 via GitHub's contents API at the pinned commit. Eight source
and header files (including version.h for provenance) are retained byte-for-byte.
The local sequential build succeeded; see `../../evidence/jackel-build-v1.json`.
The Jaeckel permission notices and Cody/Netlib provenance/disclaimer remain in
their original files; no replacement license has been applied to upstream code.
